# Yahoo

> > Yahoo is a comprehensive digital media platform offering finance, news, search, entertainment, and lifestyle content with real-time stock quotes, breaking news, and personalized services.

Yahoo provides integrated access to financial markets (including stocks, ETFs, cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Ethereum), global news coverage, celebrity entertainment, and web search capabilities. The platform aggregates content across multiple verticals including business finance, politics, sports, weather, and mail services.

## Key Topics

- Yahoo Finance
- Stock quotes and market data
- Cryptocurrency (Bitcoin USD, Ethereum USD)
- Breaking news and headlines
- Symbol lookup and trending tickers
- Business and finance news
- Entertainment and celebrity news
- Web search
- News aggregation
- Real-time market updates
- Investment companies (Caesars Entertainment, UiPath, Nebius Group)
- Energy sector (Valero Energy, Marathon Petroleum)
- Technology stocks
- Lifestyle content

## Core Services

- [Yahoo Homepage](https://us.yahoo.com/): Yahoo homepage with news, mail, weather, finance & sports aggregation
- [Yahoo Search](https://us.search.yahoo.com/;_ylt=AwrgxSLHSrJpTwIAgr9XNyoA;_ylu=Y29sbwNncTEEcG9zAzIEdnRpZAMEc2VjA3Ny): Yahoo Search engine with web, image, video & trending search features
- [Yahoo Everything](https://www.yahoo.com/all/): Complete directory of Yahoo products and services index

## Finance and Markets

- [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/?fr=sycsrp_catchall): Yahoo Finance main page with live stock quotes and market news
- [Symbol Lookup](https://finance.yahoo.com/lookup?s=ERI): Yahoo Finance ticker symbol lookup for stocks, ETFs, mutual funds & crypto

## News and Entertainment

- [Yahoo News](https://news.yahoo.com/?fr=sycsrp_catchall): Yahoo News homepage with breaking headlines and current events coverage
- [Celebrity and Entertainment](https://celebrity.yahoo.com/): Celebrity news covering Hollywood, Oscars, fashion & entertainment gossip
